QuestInfo.name: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
QuestInfo.0: I must find #b#p712##k in #b#m010006160##k and tell him that the iron corruption has been purged, making the tree bark pure enough for a magical seal.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p712##k, a friendly mediator for the fairies, explained that the living malice Caligo has consumed the Arcon. To hide the fairies' home from Caligo's gaze, he needs to cast an invisible Stasis Seal. I must gather #b30 #t4000033#s#k and #b20 #t4000057#s#k from the deeper chambers.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the catalysts to #b#p712##k, who successfully wove the invisible Stasis Seal. The corrupted beasts still roam, but the World Tree's roots have stopped decaying and the fairies are hidden from Caligo's sight. The true battle lies ahead, but we have bought them time.

0.0: Ah, welcome! I was starting to wonder who would show up once I felt the iron had been purged! Any energy seal would have failed instantly if the magic in the air still had corrupted iron in it.
0.1: I am #b#p712##k, and I try to keep the peace down here. The decay we are fighting isn't just wild magic, it is #bCaligo#k, a living malice that has consumed the Arcon, the ancient guardian of this hollow.
0.2: Caligo wants to destroy the cycle of life. We cannot banish the corrupted beasts from these tunnels today, but we can protect the roots beneath them. I must cast an invisible Stasis Seal to halt the decay and hide our home from Caligo's gaze.
0.3: I need catalysts to weave the ward. \nGather #i4000033# #b30 #t4000033#s#k and #i4000057# #b20 #t4000057#s#k. \nWill you help us secure our home?

yes.0: You have a truly kind spirit. Once you have gathered the catalysts, bring them straight to me.\nBe careful in the deep chambers. The malice is heavy there.

no.0: I understand. The shadows below are intimidating. Please, rest here until you feel ready.

1.0: You brought the catalysts! Stand back, my friend. I will channel their dormant energy into the soil to weave the ward.
1.1: ...The Stasis Seal holds! The hollow looks exactly the same, and the beasts will still wander... but place your hand on the soil. Do you feel it? The roots have stopped rotting. Caligo can no longer sense us here.
1.2: The Arcon and Caligo still lurk in the abyss, and one day we must face them. But thanks to you, we have halted the collapse. We have hope.

item.0: The roots are still too restless! I need both the #b#t4000033#s#k and the #b#t4000057#s#k to cast the seal!\nPlease, gather the rest of the catalysts.
